dedupe_keys.name: faultseg a dataset for train wheel defect detection

description: FaultSeg: A Dataset for Train Wheel Defect Detection is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Muhammad Zakir Shaikh et al. Wheels are a critical component of railway infrastructure and work as the load carrier of the train. However, defective wheels pose a serious risk to safety that can gravely jeopardize people’s safety. There is a significant risk of injury or death from defective wheels, endangering the lives of individuals. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, JSON, TXT, XML, Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 1317203799 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC0-1.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
